items.author: DavidLambauer
items.body:
When activating a project index in Serena for large repositories, the indexing process can fail or degrade performance due to large files (e.g., image folders, media directories, SQL dumps) that are not meaningful for code indexing.

It would be great to have:
* A mechanism to automatically exclude files exceeding a configurable size threshold (e.g., >10 MB).
* The ability to optionally ignore certain paths or file types (e.g., *.sql, media/, *.jpg, *.png).
* A warning or report listing excluded files so users are aware.

This would improve indexing speed, reduce unnecessary processing, and im
items.title: Enhancement: Exclude large unnecessary files (e.g., media, SQL dumps) from indexing

A lot has happened in the last 5 months on the market. For the 1.0.0 release, we should create dedicated contexts and modes as well as improved documentation for integrating Serena with the major providers. This includes the newest versions of:

- [x] Claude Code
- [x] Claude Desktop
- [x] Codex
- [ ] OpenHands CLI
- [ ] Gemini CLI
- [x] Github CLI
- [x] Copilot
- [x] JetBrains IDE agents
- [ ] Zed
- [x] VSCode

For each of those, the default context should have a tuned selection of tools and maybe some tuned prompts that help interoperability of Serena's tools with the agent's internal tools.
